Chapter One

The Story So Far

Galpotori is a video editing practice built around one idea — that footage is only raw material until it's shaped into a galpo, a story. Working from wedding reels, ceremony footage and brand shoots, I build cuts that feel unhurried, honest, and cinematic without losing the warmth of the real moment.

Every project moves through the same care: sorting the footage for its best moments, pacing the edit to the music and the emotion, grading for a consistent look, and finishing with sound that makes it feel whole.
